route_note: Frequent Gautrain trains run from Johannesburg's Park, Rosebank or Sandton stations directly to Pretoria in about 40-50 minutes, with a short connecting ride or walk to the city centre sights.
There is no direct rail line; most visitors take a shuttle or arranged transfer from Johannesburg to the Sterkfontein/Maropeng visitor centre, roughly an hour's drive.
tour_query: Cradle of Humankind day tour from Johannesburg

route_note: No public rail reaches the park; day safaris use a road transfer of about two to two-and-a-half hours from Johannesburg to the park gates.
tour_query: Pilanesberg safari day trip from Johannesburg
